title: Historic European bronze for Moldovan table tennis
excerpt: Andrei Puțuntică and Vladislav Ursu won bronze in the men's doubles at the European Senior Championships in Ljubljana, a first for the Republic of Moldova.
body_html:
Table tennis in the Republic of Moldova marks a new landmark achievement on the international stage. Andrei PUȚUNTICĂ and Vladislav URSU won bronze medals in the men's doubles at the European Senior Championships in Ljubljana, Slovenia, a first in the history of the sport in our country.

The Moldovan pair's run was remarkable. After wins in qualifying against players from the Czech Republic and Poland, they continued their convincing form in the main draw, knocking out opponents from England, Germany and Belgium in turn, which secured them a place in the semi-finals and, with it, a European medal.

In the semi-final, Moldova's representatives met the strong Swedish pair Anton KÄLLBERG/Kristian KARLSSON, losing 0-3 and finishing the competition on the third step of the continental podium.

The result is historic: it is the first medal won by the Republic of Moldova at the European Senior Championships in men's doubles by a pair made up entirely of Moldovan players.

For Vladislav Ursu, it is a second European senior bronze, after the medal he won in 2024 in the same event alongside Austria's Maciej KOLODZIEJCZYK.

Beyond its sporting value, the success in Ljubljana confirms that Moldovan table tennis can compete at the highest continental level. It is an important milestone for the sport and an example of ambition and perseverance for the young generation of players.

The players' travel and participation in the European Championships were made possible with the support of Setka-Pro, general partner of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova, and of the National Sports Association ATTP, whose involvement helps Moldovan athletes compete at the highest international level.

The National Sports Association ATTP congratulates the whole national squad on this exceptional achievement and wishes them further success in international competitions!
